title: 第十一章 冥烛点青灯，夜半打更人
slug: 这个文字冒险游戏绝对有毒
content_zh:
沐游急忙点击文本，查看起这次的收获。
【打更人的南瓜灯：打更人在夜里巡逻时用于照明的灯具，点亮后，可映照出一些肉眼无法看到的事物。事件触发率增加30%，仅限夜间生效。】
“提灯？”
沐游一怔，点击了一下南瓜灯的文本。
下一瞬，一把造型诡异的南瓜提灯出现在他手中。
金黄色的南瓜头上，雕刻出一个鬼脸的形象，南瓜内部则被掏空，中间被放置了一个透明瓶子，瓶子中盛满了一些粉末状漂浮颗粒，不断向外散发着点点荧光。
而在南瓜顶端的绳子上，还连接着一根长约两尺的木棍，一端连着南瓜灯，另一端被沐游握在手中。
“能映照出‘肉眼无法看到的事物’……这是指什么？鬼魂？幽灵？”
沐游皱眉看着文本中的这句说明。
想了想，他提起南瓜灯，朝四周的地面照了照试验了一下。
结果自然是毫无异常。
在白天的强光衬托下，南瓜灯散发的荧光被掩盖到微不可查的地步。
更何况，游戏说明中还特意提到了，南瓜灯的效果‘仅限夜间生效’。
“看来只能等晚上再尝试了。”
沐游摇了摇头，再次点击了‘南瓜灯’的文本，将南瓜灯收回到游戏中，随后又看向游戏中的下一件物品。
【打更背包：一个被释放过空间咒语的背包，内部封存有一个长宽高均为100米的异世界空间（可融合同类空间物品，扩展内部空间范围）。外表可变形为任意背包样式，内部亦可随时切换为异界空间或普通背包模式。】
“这不就是储物袋嘛！”
沐游看得一愣，经历过大量电影和小说荼毒的他，自然明白一个储物道具在异世界探索中的作用有多么巨大。
急忙点击背包的文本。
一个黑布做成的线拉束口小包，出现在沐游手中。

只不过这背包却只有巴掌大小，与其说是背包，还不如说是一个布袋子。
但当沐游拉开束口，往里看了眼，顿时惊呆。
这口袋中果然连接了一个异世界入口！
往下看去，有隐隐光线传来，下方似乎是一间木棚屋的内部，沿着布袋口往下，已经架好了一面梯子，方便进出。
只可惜袋子口太小，沐游伸一个胳膊进去已经是极限。
“话说文本中写着这背包好像能自由变形来着……这要怎么变？”
沐游看着手里的口袋，想了想，将其平放在地上，随后在脑海里尝试着想象了一个旅行箱的外貌。
随着噗的一声轻响，巴掌大小的口袋，居然真的变成一个带滚轮和托把的大旅行箱子。
沐游拉开箱子拉链，掀开之后，里面果然还是那个异世界木棚屋，而之前巴掌大的缝隙，此时也已经变成了一米见方的入口，这下想要进去肯定绰绰有余了。
沐游走到门口把门上了锁，把窗帘拉好，这才走回箱子旁边，沿着下方连接的梯子，踏入了箱子内部。
下来楼梯，沐游转头看去，呈现在他眼前的是一个不到三十平米的小木屋，屋内有一张粗糙的木板床，上面铺着一层厚厚的干草，不远处还有一张木制的工作台，上面摆放着各种空瓶子和器皿。
除此之外就没了，整间屋子看起来就像是一间废弃已久的工作室。
看了一圈，沐游最后走到棚屋的门前，推开门走了出去。
耀眼的光线传来，小屋之外，居然是一片堪比足球场的草地，地面上长满了茵茵绿草，空气清新，而且光线很充足。
沐游抬头看去，在天空中的四个角落，箱子的边缘痕迹隐约可见。
而在他头顶的正上方，漂浮着一颗朦胧的光球，不断散发出柔和的白光，正是它充当着光源，照亮了整片空间。
沐游好奇的走到空间的边缘，试着伸手朝前触摸了一下。
结果前方似乎被一面无形的墙壁隔绝着，手靠近过去就会立即被弹回来。
他又去其他几个方向试了试，结果还是一样，四面都被无形墙壁封堵，从哪个方向都无法踏出空间一步。
这场景倒是让他想起了电影《楚门的世界》，这地方怎么看，都像是从一个真实世界中，强行分割出的一块独立空间，当然，这空间的大小可比楚门的世界要袖珍多了，当做储物空间肯定是绰绰有余，但想要在这里面长期生活，却几乎不可能。

“不过，既然这背包在游戏和现实中都可以
当沐游从小棚屋屋顶的背包入口，重新回到现实的房间中时，他脑海里忽然冒出了这个念头。
想到就做，他立即去找了个空水杯，丢进小棚屋内。
随后将箱子拉上，又尝试在游戏里
结果屏幕中弹出提示：【警告：背包中含有未知物品，无法
“果然不行么……”
沐游苦笑了一下，背包中只要有存在地球这边放进去的东西，在游戏中就直接无法
看来想要取巧穿过‘墙’，直接去到对面的巫师世界，并没有那么容易。
好在，这个限制并不会影响背包在现实中的使用。
反正游戏里沐游目前也是一穷二白的状态，短时间内根本用不着这背包来装东西，这背包就干脆留在现实中使用好了。
收起背包，沐游这才看向最后一件道具。
【打更人皮肤：冥烛点青灯，夜半打更人！加载后游戏角色将替换为‘打更人’。ps：穿戴皮肤可使愚者的游戏人物呈现出对应的外观和身份，且可在现实中具现。已拥有的皮肤可随时切换，属性和等级继承。】
【打更人：为村庄居民报时的职业，也承担着一部分夜间巡逻的任务。固定任务：每日零点至凌晨四点期间，外出巡逻至少一小时，即可获得一年寿命，该任务每日上限一次！】
“任务！？”
沐游看得一愣，旋即大喜。
他就说这游戏不应该只消耗寿命，却无法获得寿命。
原来获得寿命的办法，就是替代游戏中的某个原住民，完成他们原本的工作，就可以获得寿命作为报酬！
是了，如果把寿命看做那个世界的货币，那么完成工作，获得报酬，确实是合情合理的逻辑。
content_en:
Mu You hurriedly clicked on the text to check out this harvest.
[The watchman’s jack-o’-lantern: a lamp used for lighting when the watchman patrols at night. When lit, it can reflect things that cannot be seen with the naked eye. The event trigger rate is increased by 30%, effective only at night. 】
"Lantern?"
Mu You was startled and clicked on the text of the pumpkin lantern.
The next moment, a strange-looking pumpkin lantern appeared in his hand.
The head of the golden pumpkin is carved with the image of a grimace, and the inside of the pumpkin is hollowed out. A transparent bottle is placed in the middle. The bottle is filled with some powdery floating particles, which constantly emit little bits of fluorescence.
On the rope at the top of the pumpkin, there is also a wooden stick about two feet long. One end is connected to the pumpkin lantern, and the other end is held by Mu You in his hand.
"Can reflect 'things that cannot be seen with the naked eye'... What does this mean? Ghost? Ghost?"
Mu You frowned and looked at the explanation in the text.
After thinking about it, he lifted up the pumpkin lantern and looked at the surrounding ground to test it.
The result was naturally nothing unusual.
Under the strong light of the day, the fluorescence emitted by the jack-o-lantern is obscured to the point of being undetectable.
What's more, the game description specifically mentions that the effect of the jack-o'-lantern 'only takes effect at night'.
"It seems we can only wait until tonight to try again."
Mu You shook his head, clicked on the text of 'Pumpkin Lantern' again, put the pumpkin lantern back into the game, and then looked at the next item in the game.
[Backpack: A backpack that has been released by a space spell. There is a different world space with a length, width and height of 100 meters sealed inside (it can be integrated with similar space items to expand the scope of the internal space). The exterior can be transformed into any backpack style, and the interior can also be switched to otherworldly space or ordinary backpack mode at any time. 】
"Isn't this just a storage bag?"
Mu You was stunned for a moment. Having experienced the abuse of a large number of movies and novels, he naturally understood how important a storage prop was in exploring another world.
Hastily click on the text of the backpack.
A small string-top bag made of black cloth appeared in Mu You's hand.
However, this backpack is only about the size of a palm. It is more like a cloth bag than a backpack.
But when Mu You opened the gauze and looked inside, he was stunned.
This pocket is indeed connected to a portal to another world!
Looking down, there is a faint light coming from it. It seems to be the interior of a wooden shed below. Along the mouth of the bag, a ladder has been set up for easy entry and exit.
It's a pity that the mouth of the bag is too small, and Mu You can't reach his limit by stretching an arm in.
"By the way, the text says that this backpack seems to be able to transform freely... How can this be changed?"
Mu You looked at the pocket in his hand, thought for a moment, laid it flat on the ground, and then tried to imagine the appearance of a suitcase in his mind.
With a soft popping sound, the palm-sized pocket actually turned into a large travel suitcase with rollers and handles.
Mu You unzipped the box, and after opening it, it turned out that it was still the wooden shack from another world inside, and the gap that was the size of a palm before had now become a one-meter-square entrance, which was definitely more than enough to get in now.
Mu You walked to the door, locked the door, and closed the curtains. Then he walked back to the box, followed the ladder connected below, and stepped into the box.
Coming down the stairs, Mu You turned around and looked around. What appeared in front of him was a small wooden house less than thirty square meters. There was a rough wooden bed in the house, covered with a thick layer of hay. There was a wooden workbench not far away, with various empty bottles and utensils placed on it.
Other than that, there was nothing else, and the whole room looked like a long-abandoned studio.
After looking around, Mu You finally walked to the door of the shack, opened the door and walked out.
Dazzling light came, and outside the hut, there was actually a grass field comparable to a football field.The ground is covered with green grass, the air is fresh, and there is plenty of light.
Mu You looked up and saw that the edges of the box were faintly visible in the four corners of the sky.
And directly above his head, there was a hazy ball of light floating, constantly emitting soft white light. It was it that acted as a light source, illuminating the entire space.
Mu You curiously walked to the edge of the space and tried to reach forward and touch it.
As a result, the front seems to be isolated by an invisible wall, and your hand will be bounced back immediately if you approach it.
He tried several other directions, but the result was still the same. All sides were blocked by invisible walls, and he could not take a step out of space from any direction.
This scene reminded him of the movie "The Truman Show". No matter how you look at this place, it looks like an independent space forcibly separated from the real world. Of course, the size of this space is much smaller than that of The Truman Show. It is definitely more than enough as a storage space, but it is almost impossible to live in it for a long time.
"However, since this backpack can be used both in the game and in reality,
When Mu You returned to the real room through the backpack entrance on the roof of the small shed, this idea suddenly came to his mind.
He did what he thought of and immediately found an empty water glass and threw it into the shack.
Then I zipped up the box and tried again in the game
A prompt pops up on the result screen: [Warning: The backpack contains unknown items and cannot be
"It really doesn't work..."
Mu You smiled bitterly. As long as there are things in the backpack that exist on the earth side, they will not be directly accessible in the game.
It seems that it is not that easy to get through the 'wall' and go directly to the wizarding world on the opposite side.
Fortunately, this limitation does not affect the practical use of the backpack.
Anyway, Muyou is currently in a state of poverty in the game, and there is no need for this backpack to carry things in a short period of time, so he might as well keep this backpack for use in reality.
After putting away his backpack, Mu You looked at the last prop.
[Watchman skin: Dark candles light green lanterns, watch the clock in the middle of the night! After loading, the game character will be replaced by the 'watchman'. ps: Wearing skins can give the Fool’s game character a corresponding appearance and identity, and can be realized in reality. Skins you already own can be switched at any time, and attributes and levels are inherited. 】
[Watchman: A job that tells the time for village residents, and also undertakes part of the night patrol tasks. Fixed task: Between 00:00 and 4:00 a.m. every day, if you go out on patrol for at least one hour, you can gain one year of life. This task is limited to once per day! 】
"Mission! ? "
Mu You was stunned for a moment, then overjoyed.
He said that this game should not only consume lifespan, but cannot gain lifespan.
It turns out that the way to gain lifespan is to replace a certain aboriginal in the game and complete their original work, and you will receive lifespan as a reward!
Yes, if life is regarded as the currency of that world, then completing the work and getting paid is indeed a reasonable logic.
